scenes.title: Teen Pulse, Ek Pause
narration: ALARM! ...nahi, ye alarm nahi. Bridge ki badi screen par waves — teen pulse, ek pause, teen pulse, ek pause. Dr. Krishnan kaanp rahe hain — 'Ye... ye NATURAL nahi hai! Ye... MESSAGE hai!'
Captain Rao shaant hain, par unki mutthi bhinchi hai — 'Cadet. Tum sabse young ho. Sphatik research kehti hai young minds... sun sakte hain. Headphones lagao. Batao — kya SUN rahe ho?'
Tum headphones lagate ho. Shor ke beech... ek DHUN. Jaise koi door se gaa raha ho. Tumhari aankhein bheeg jaati hain — pata nahi kyun.
fallbackLines: Signal repeat ho raha hai. Poori bridge tumhe dekh rahi hai. Tumne kya suna — darr? Dosti? Ya madad ki pukaar?
Dr. Krishnan fusfusate hain — 'Batao beta... pehla impression sabse sachcha hota hai.'

choices.text: 'Ye madad maang raha hai, sir. Koi musibat mein hai!'

memory: User ne signal ko madad ki pukaar samjha — sahi nikla.

choices.text: 'Sir... ye to... gaa raha hai? Koi gaana hai.'

memory: User ne signal mein dhun suni — Sphatik ke liye ye greeting thi.

scenes.title: First Contact
narration: Airlock 3 khulta hai. Andar... SHEESHA. Ek crystal being — Krr-tik — tumhe dekh ke chamka. Uske dimag se seedha tumhare dimag mein awaaz — 'YOUNG-MIND! Tum... SHOR nahi karte! Tum... SUNTE ho!'
Dr. Krishnan behosh hote-hote bache — 'First... first contact... PROTOCOL! Cadet, pehla shabd TUM bologe! Soch ke — Sphatik mein ek galat shabd... matlab yuddh!'
Krr-tik tumhari taraf badha. Uska crystal-heart flicker kar raha hai — wo kamzor ho raha hai. Pehla shabd, cadet. History likhi jaa rahi hai.
fallbackLines: Krr-tik tumhe dekh raha hai. Uski roshni dheemi pad rahi hai. Pehla shabd kya hoga?
Zoya fusfusati hai — 'Gaana suna de! Aliens ko music pasand hai, movies mein dekha hai!' Dr. Krishnan — 'Nahi! Formal greeting!'

choices.text: Haath jod ke — 'Namaste. Main dost hoon.'

memory: User ka pehla Sphatik shabd: Namaste. Krr-tik ne dosti qubool ki.
User ne Krr-tik ko Hindi gaana sunaya — wo khushi se chamak utha.

scenes.title: Dying Crystal-Heart
narration: Krr-tik ke mind-link se pata chala: uska ship toota hai, crystal-heart dying hai, aur HIVE-SHIP 4 ghante mein aa raha hai! 'Hive... sochega... humans ne... Krr-tik ko... TODA. Phir... YUDDH-ka-shor.'

Zoya ne turant scan kiya — 'Baby-2 ka spare crystal fit ho sakta hai! Par... ship ki power aadhi ho jayegi. Captain, permission?' Captain Rao ne tumhe dekha — 'Cadet. Ye tumhara first contact hai. Faisla TUMHARA.'
Spare crystal lagana = Vikrant kamzor. Na lagana = Krr-tik... silence. Sphatik mein silence matlab maut.
fallbackLines: 4 ghante baaki. Krr-tik ki roshni dheemi ho rahi hai. Crystal lagao — ya koi aur jugaad?
Engine room taiyaar hai. Zoya spanner ghuma rahi hai. Captain order ka intezaar kar rahe hain.

choices.text: Spare crystal lagao — Krr-tik ko bachana hai!

memory: User ne Vikrant ka spare crystal deke Krr-tik ki jaan bachayi.

choices.text: Aadhi power share karo — dheere charge karo (safe option)

memory: User ne safe option chuna — dheemi charging.

scenes.title: Hive Aa Raha Hai
narration: RED ALERT! Screen par — HIVE-SHIP! Chand jitna bada crystal jahaz! Message aaya — translate hua: 'YOUNG-SCOUT-KRR-TIK... STATUS?... HUMANS... HOSTILE?... JAWAB... DO.'
Krr-tik abhi kamzor hai — bol nahi sakta. Hive ko saboot chahiye: humans dost hain ya dushman? Captain Rao — 'Cadet, tumne dosti shuru ki. Tum khatm karo. Hive se kya kahein?'
Dr. Krishnan — 'Ek galat shabd... aur...' Zoya — 'Arre, unko repair dikha do! Jhooth nahi, jugaad dikhao!'
fallbackLines: Hive-ship nazdeek aa raha hai. 10 minute. Krr-tik ishara kar raha hai — wo kuch kehna chahta hai, par kamzor hai.
Saboot? Message? Ya Krr-tik ko hi saamne lao?

choices.text: Live feed par repair dikhao — 'Humne use bachaya hai!'
Krr-tik ko support karke hive se khud baat karwao

scenes.title: Ending: Pehla Samjhauta
narration: Live feed par hive ne dekha — humans ne unke scout ko bachaya. Lambi silence... phir message: 'HUMANS... HEALERS. HIVE... THANKS. PEACE... ACCEPTED.'
History ban gayi! Pehla interstellar peace treaty — aur us par sign karne wala sabse young cadet: TUM. Captain Rao ne salute kiya — 'Cadet... nahi. LIEUTENANT.'
Krr-tik ne jaate-jaate ek chhota crystal diya — 'Dosti-ka-shor... hamesha... tumhare paas.' Wo crystal aaj bhi Vikrant museum mein 'pehli dosti' ke naam se rakha hai.
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

scenes.title: Ending: Gaane Wala Yuddh-Viram
narration: Krr-tik ne kamzor awaaz mein hive se kaha — aur phir... USNE WO HINDI GAANA GAYA jo tumne sikhaya tha! Tooti-phooti awaaz mein... par dil se!
Hive-ship ki saari roshni... NEELE se SUNEHRI ho gayi! Message aaya: 'SCOUT... HAPPY-NOISE... HUMANS... FRIENDS. HIVE... SINGS... TOO.' Poori fleet ne milke... GAANA GAYA!
Us din space mein pehli baar 'concert' hua — 120 humans + 1 million Sphatik. Zoya royi — 'Baby-2, ye moment record kar lena!' Aur tum? Tum ban gaye — galaxy ke pehle DJ-Cadet!
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

endings.title: Gaane Wala Yuddh-Viram
endings.description: Gaane se fleet ka dil jeeta.
